descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Hello, let’s meet! 
 Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 
 We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture. 
 In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more.
 You will be: 
managing and maintaining cloud infrastructure and supporting development teams with infrastructure-related issues,
setting up, configuring, and managing distributed infrastructure components and services,
designing and maintaining CI/CD solutions and supporting the delivery process,
coordinating DevOps and infrastructure activities across multiple teams and stakeholders,
troubleshooting and resolving infrastructure and service integration issues,
supporting reliable communication between application services and infrastructure components,
providing technical guidance and recommendations during planning and design sessions,
ensuring infrastructure changes and implementations meet agreed technical requirements.
 Your profile: 
strong hands-on experience with AWS and DevOps engineering,
practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery,
practical experience with AWS CLI, AWS SSO, IAM, IAM Identity Center, and AWS Systems Manager,
experience managing AWS infrastructure using CloudFormation and Git,
strong knowledge of AWS services including ECS, Fargate, EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudFront, PrivateLink, ALB, NLB, and Transit Gateway,
experience with AWS security and identity services such as Cognito, Secrets Manager, IAM, and Organizations,
experience with AWS monitoring and auditing tools such as CloudWatch and CloudTrail,
hands-on experience managing Redis clusters, including Redis Streams,
experience with Elasticsearch/Elastic Cloud and Kibana,
experience managing IBM MQ clusters,
strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across distributed applications and infrastructure,
experience with Docker and containerized environments,
understand CI/CD principles and have experience designing and maintaining deployment pipelines,
strong communication and coordination skills and are comfortable working across multiple technical teams,
can provide technical guidance and contribute to infrastructure and solution design discussions,
good English communication skills (at least B2 level).
 Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required. 
 Recruitment Process: 
 CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
